Definition: from G1401; to be a slave to (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary):--be in bondage, (do) serve(-ice).
BiblicalUsage: To serve as a slave, to be in bondage, the word for Israel's four hundred years in Egypt and for the Thessalonians who turned from idols to serve the living and true God. Paul tells servants to serve their masters well, and the Colossians that the service they give is really service to the Lord Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe serving God is the only slavery that sets me free, because the Master I serve gave Himself for me. Israel was freed from Egypt to serve God, and I was freed from idols for the same purpose.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
